# Sociotechnical Systems-of-Systems for Resilience

**Facilitator:** G. Kennedy  
**Contributors:** J. Dahmann, A. Harding, S. Ronning, R. Rookwood (Project Wildfire)  

## Abstract
This session launches HSI WG involvement in Project Wildfire, examining human and systemic resilience dimensions of wildfire emergency management.

## Focus Dimensions
- Extreme environmental conditions
- Sustainment & support logistics
- Wellbeing of responders & communities
- Community recovery & rebuilding
- Multi-agency teamwork & coordination
- System-of-Systems considerations
